name: run-tools
description: The tool-probe export of the gauntlet harness, Tools/gauntlet/harness/run.mjs (probeAxisTools), and its Jet twin in the Axis module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/gauntlet/kit/Source/Axis.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver that probes the tools of each fixture case through Tools/agent/JetEnv.jet: the Jet binary as a file, absent and a directory; sh and the shell builtins true and false (whose version command fails); entr, whose own version command (-V) fails; an absent tool and names a shell must quote (an apostrophe, a dollar sign and a space); and runners that declare no tools or tools that are not a list. Paths in the case directory read <cwd>; store paths, tool versions and stderr are masked, so a dev-shell update changes no output. Then an unknown command (exit 64).
